title: OhCamel Alpha signal, v1
description: One document per signal, written by the Python research layer and enforced by the OCaml core. The core treats every temporal field as a claim to be checked against its own clock. See interface/README.md for the rules (R1-R8) and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-02-ohcamel-alpha-design.md for why each field exists.

strategy.description: Slug. Must be registered with the core (R2).

params_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical (sorted-key, no-whitespace) JSON of the strategy parameters.

as_of.description: The bar date at whose CLOSE the signal was computed. Actionable at the next open. Checked against the core's bar clock (R3, R4).

computed_at.description: Wall-clock time of computation, RFC 3339 UTC. Informational; the core does not act on it.

data_hash.description: SHA-256 over the bars the strategy read, so the core can verify Python saw the data the core has (R8, Phase 2).

sequence.description: Monotonic per strategy. A file at or below the last accepted sequence is rejected (R5).

status.description: Only pass may trade (R6). fail and unvalidated are advisory: logged, never sized.

gates_version.description: Version of docs/CHARTER.md gates the battery applied, e.g. 2026-09-02.

manifest.description: Path or content hash of the battery manifest this block was written from.

targets.description: Target portfolio weights. Each |weight| <= 1 and the sum of |weight| <= 1 (R7). An empty array means flat.
